subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw show the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move it to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery in the CLI only?
rationale: The source-level implementation can be narrow, but the issue is explicitly about user-visible placement and makes an absolute local path prominent in the Control UI.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land a display-only row using the existing admin-scoped snapshot configPath after real running-Control-UI proof is provided.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing field to appear in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline new UI exposure and rely on `openclaw config file` plus existing diagnostics for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land a display-only row using the existing admin-scoped snapshot configPath after real running-Control-UI proof is provided.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged history in the Overview presentation surface where this visible row would land.
